posts.author: Stephanov
posts.title: Re: Remove Sdoor Tool
posts.html:
All your arguements are complete and utter poo.


1st. I most of the times leave my doors under the name ||VM|| Stephanov. Just to show of ma coolness, yo!


2nd. Keypads are no longer required since all doors can be locked, opened and used. (Opened using E)


3rd. Police officers ARE NOT allowed to warrant anyone unless they have witnessed them commiting a crime. If the police have not seen you commiting a crime and they warrant you, they are random warranting.


4th. Good, if you can't see the name I consider that a feature, not a bug. Since you seem to LIKE random warranting.


5th. 20 people? Pfffft. You can ask arround. Some raiders on this server can take out an entire installation with only 3-4 players. Even though most of their raids are frowned upon. <_<
I've seen bases of 5 people being taken out by solo's a lot of times.


Additionally:
If you really want to know who owns shit, organise a stake-out outside their base. Someone will try to come in or out eventually. Then you have a name. You can take them for questioning. What you CAN'T DO, is randomly arrest people unless you've seen them committing a crime.

posts.author: L3w1s
posts.title: Re: Remove Sdoor Tool
posts.html:
You don't need a keypad, that'd be like HAVING to put a keypad on the 'door with bar' before the update took place.
People can't stay inside forever. They'll need food, and even if they change class and go back to the house, it'll be a dead giveaway when they just walk inside. It's just a question of patience.

And the two doors in a row rule only counts for said Sdoors. So, in the radio station, you could have an sdoor, the front door, an sdoor, then your contra behind one of the interior doors. As long as there's plenty of space between the sdoors and the map doors, there's no problem with that.
